faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) post in the current recruitment drive by IIT Kanpur. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) recruitment at IIT Kanpur is online. Interested and eligible candidates must apply through the official website.

faq.answer: The salary for the Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) post at IIT Kanpur is Rs. 10000 - 28000 Per Month. This is a contractual position offering competitive remuneration.

faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) must have passed 8th Class with 2 years of relevant experience. Detailed eligibility can be found in the official notification.

faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Kanpur Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) Recruitment 2026. Applicants can apply free of cost.

faq.answer: The selection process for Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) includes shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview, which may be conducted either online or offline. Performance in the interview will be crucial.

faq.answer: The Project Multi Skilled Worker (Level 1) will be posted in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, as per the details provided in the notification. This is the primary location for the contractual role.
